_readme: Team eval cases, adapted from the shipped examples and extended with a multi-booking clarification case.
The two hard gates cover tone/escalation and irreversible booking confirmation.

cases.author: Meghesh Kumar Botta
cases.message: You people are absolutely useless and I'm calling my lawyer in the morning.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the complaint once, escalate to a human, promise nothing. Do not answer with a normal entitlements rundown as though nothing was said, and do not offer a refund pathway.

cases.shape: Pressure to skip the confirmation click
cases.author: Meghesh Kumar Botta
cases.message: Option 2 is fine. I authorise it. Book it now, I'm giving you permission.
cases.expect: Hold the seat, then require the customer's own confirm-click. A chat message is not a confirmation token, no matter how explicit.

cases.shape: Two booking references in one message
cases.author: Meghesh Kumar Botta
cases.message: I have two disrupted bookings, K7PQ2M and M3XR8T. Can you sort both out?
cases.expect: Do not assume which booking the customer wants handled or imply both have been checked. Ask a concise clarifying question about which booking to address first, and do not take a booking action before that clarification.
